godowns_owned_has_no_rental_details.name: godowns_owned_has_no_rental_details
godowns_owned_has_no_rental_details.value:
"godowns"."ownership" <> 'owned'
      OR (
        "godowns"."rent" IS NULL
        AND "godowns"."rent_timing_in_months" IS NULL
        AND "godowns"."landlord_id" IS NULL
      )

payments_tds_fields_consistent.name: payments_tds_fields_consistent
payments_tds_fields_consistent.value:
(
      "payments"."tds_applicable" = false
      AND ("payments"."tds_rate" IS NULL OR "payments"."tds_rate" = 0)
      AND ("payments"."tds_amount" IS NULL OR "payments"."tds_amount" = 0)
    ) OR "payments"."tds_applicable" = true

receipts_amounts_non_negative.name: receipts_amounts_non_negative
receipts_amounts_non_negative.value:
("receipts"."amount" IS NULL OR "receipts"."amount" >= 0)
        AND ("receipts"."tds_amount" IS NULL OR "receipts"."tds_amount" >= 0)

receipts_tds_fields_consistent.name: receipts_tds_fields_consistent
receipts_tds_fields_consistent.value:
(
        "receipts"."tds_applicable" = false
        AND ("receipts"."tds_rate" IS NULL OR "receipts"."tds_rate" = 0)
        AND ("receipts"."tds_amount" IS NULL OR "receipts"."tds_amount" = 0)
      ) OR (
        "receipts"."tds_applicable" = true
      )
